name: Alea
description:
About This Game

Storm into Alea and demolish your enemies! In this high-pressure arena battler, each character has two distinct combat forms, allowing you to adopt a playstyle that is uniquely your own. Shift from defence to offense at the press of a button to outsmart, out-manoeuvre, and out-combo your opponent. Craving another battle? Immediately launch into another fast-paced battle with MMR-based matchmaking, and blaze your way up the public leaderboards.

FEATURES

  • Rapid, high-intensity matches with seamless matchmaking mean that you can make quick work of your opponents whenever you feel like it.

  • Carry your team to victory. Rise the ranks in high skill-ceiling 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 arena matches and earn respect from your fellow warriors.

  • Show off your quick thinking and master combat styles of every hero, adapting to any situation like few others can.

  • Outside the arena, engage with the community and have an impact on the future of Alea - with a responsive, active development team and regular updates and patches.

MASTER YOUR HERO AND CRUSH YOUR OPPONENTS

Earn respect from your fellow combatants by battling your way up the ranks, with intense battles that you’ll always have time for. Outplay your opponents by mastering form swapping, allowing you to start a fight with pressure and quickly pivot for a tactical retreat, ready for a counter-push!

MAKE ALLIES AS WELL AS ENEMIES

When you begin dominating the arena, the community is sure to take notice. Make allies on the battlefield and bring them up to your level - or carry them to victory. Find allies in Discord or via MMR-based online matchmaking in 2v2 and 3v3 modes, and make a name for yourself.
short_desc: Intense, fast-paced arena battles with a high skill ceiling. Alea is a skill-first hero brawler with quick, high-pressure matches and a broad array of characters. Master two sides of every hero and forge a playstyle that is uniquely your own to outplay your rivals in 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 matches.
